name: inspect
eval: (async()=>{ const wait=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms)); const rail=document.querySelector('[data-context-rail]'); const sec=document.querySelector('[data-context-section=customer]'); const sample=async(el)=>{let samples=[];for(let i=0;i<25;i++){await wait(20);samples.push({w:Math.round(el.getBoundingClientRect().width),h:Math.round(el.getBoundingClientRect().height),animations:el.getAnimations().map(a=>({t:a.currentTime,frames:a.effect.getKeyframes()}))});}return samples;}; sec.querySelector('button').click(); const section=await sample(sec.querySelector('.context-section-body')||sec); document.querySelector('[aria-label="Hide customer details"]').click(); const closing=await sample(rail); document.querySelector('[data-context-toggle]').click(); const opening=await sample(rail); return {section,closing,opening};})()
